name: TGC
fix_description: The claim/reward function (0xfd5a466f) calculates token price using raw balanceOf() calls on the pair address: price = tokenA.balanceOf(pair) / tokenB.balanceOf(pair). An attacker can flash-loan manipulate pair reserves to inflate the price ratio, then claim inflated rewards. Fix: use a TWAP oracle or Chainlink price feed instead of instantaneous pair balances for price calculation.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a short but protocol-specific multi-step attack: swap into the target token, interact with a vulnerable contract function, warp time, then use a PancakePair callback/flash-swap style interaction to realize profit. It is not a trivial access-control bug, but it also does not involve a long cross-protocol chain or deep accounting complexity, so an experienced auditor would likely need protocol understanding but not several hours.
